estadisticas.embudo_sub: How many leads are in each board column today.
estadisticas.mes_sub: Sum of the amount entered on leads, by the month the lead arrived (last 12 months).
estadisticas.mes_vacio: No amounts entered on any lead yet.
estadisticas.depto_sub: Requires departments to be set up (tag your WhatsApp accounts from the super-admin, and create employees under "Employees").
estadisticas.resp_sub: How long it takes between a new lead arriving via WhatsApp and someone on the team replying by hand from the lead card (the automatic reply, which is instant, doesn't count).
estadisticas.resp_vacio: No lead has been answered by hand from the CRM yet.
estadisticas.emp_hint: Each employee only sees the leads of the department you assign. You (Management) still see everything.
estadisticas.emp_ninguno: You haven't added any employees yet.
estadisticas.emp_confirmar_borrar: Delete this employee? They will no longer be able to log in to the CRM.
